outcome: Scheduled jobs now ask for permission one way only: the job card, with exactly Allow and Deny, for every request a run makes — including commands that cannot be saved as a rule. Those rows read "<command> (this run only)"; Allow lets the run continue once and saves nothing, Deny denies, and if the run ends first the row shows "Expired — the run ended before a decision; it will ask again next run". The old chat-prompt fallback (which had degenerated to a Cancel-only prompt and left a run stuck) is gone; an un-raisable card denies the tool call with a plain reason. Piped commands no longer get "allow for future" suggestions anywhere. Proven live: run a2fbf7bc asked for a piped curl, Allow was tapped, the run resumed six seconds later, no rule was written.
